body.name: Outcome-nonrestrictive identification on \(\mathcal M\)
body.construction: The vector \((\mu_t^\star)_{t\in\mathcal B}\) is outcome-nonrestrictively identified on \(\mathcal M\) when any two laws satisfying the maintained assumptions, supported on \(\mathcal M\), having \(p^\star>0\), and inducing the same \(P_{\mathrm{obs}}\), have the same vector \((\mu_t^\star)_{t\in\mathcal B}\), without any further restriction on the conditional law of \((Y(t))_{t\in\mathcal B}\) given \(G\).
